name: Approveit
description: Approveit is a simple way to streamline internal approval processes like: access requests, software releases, quotes, docs, even PTOs - all through Slack.

events.d: Update form values, priority or approvers of a pending or sent-back approval request.
Submit a new approval request in a chosen workflow with its form values and approvers.
List approval requests filtered by status, priority, workflow, dates or number.
Retrieves approval request details, form values, and approval steps for a specified request number.
